Code Listings

Readable source code in papers: a listings style with line numbers and highlighting, listing floats, inline code and file input.

What it adds

  • Snippet: Listings style (preamble)
  • Snippet: Code listing
  • Snippet: Inline code
  • Snippet: Code from a file

Install Code Listings

In LatexDo, open the Extensions view, find Code Listings and choose Install. It is free.
